title: Reference subtitles
help: Read-only reference; never imports into your subtitles or timeline. UTF-8 SRT only, up to 1MiB and 5000 segments.
saved: Reference subtitles saved. Open workspaces update on return, focus, or their next status check.
noMatch: No reference matches the current interval
invalidVersion: Reference version must be a positive integer.
conflict: Reference subtitles changed. Refresh the project version and retry; your inputs are retained.
